verdict.rationale: OpenClaw documents SecretRefs, so supported credentials need not sit as plaintext in config. Its secrets-management docs describe a shared secret store, runtime snapshots, and one-way scrubbing (redaction). Isolated cells and agents also get their own credentials and auth, which gives separation. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that keys pasted into chat or session history are prevented or scrubbed, which credential types SecretRefs actually cover (docs say only 'supported' ones), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
